base: Use case: stylized-concept. Redesign an ORIGINAL farm-game character in the SAME appealing rounded comic-cartoon style as the attached wolf atlas. Inspired by U.S. Acres / Orson's Farm: funny, CUTE, soft bean shapes, large simple white oval eyes with small black pupils, generous muzzles/beaks, thick clean BLACK ink, cheerful FLAT colors. NO fine texture, fur strokes, realistic anatomy, pixel art, gradients, glossy3D, or baby-chibi proportions. Reference is STYLE AND SHEET FORMAT ONLY; do not draw the wolf.
layout: Production SPRITE ATLAS on a true transparent RGBA background. EXACTLY FIVE ROWS and TWELVE COLUMNS,60 distinct drawings. Wide3072x2048. All equalcells. Character occupies ONLY65%cell width and70%height, with CLEAR transparent gutters between ALL cells and generous outside margin. No overlap or clipping, no backgrounds, shadows, ground, labels, text, gridlines. Whole body visible including tail, ears, nose, paws. FIVE genuine views: row1 RIGHT/EAST side profile; row2 DOWN-RIGHT/SE45deg; row3 DOWN/SOUTH FRONT; row4 UP-RIGHT/NE rear45deg; row5 UP/NORTH BACK. Constant orthographic camera15degrees elevated, SAME model proportions and drawing scale for allviews. Head/torso keep same pivot and size, stable groundline. Each row ONE seamless TWELVE-frame WALK, no duplicated endpoint or inserted idle. Frames1and7 opposite foot CONTACTS; frames4and10 opposite PASSING; otherframes gradual hand-drawn inbetweens. No changing body shape/size/camera midcycle. Supporting foot moves back smoothly on the ground, lifts and bends only for return. Equal left/right stride, clear feet, subtle secondary follow-through.
